title: The Last Ember Anew
author: Gideon Zhou
blurb: Ada Dravenmoor, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
